description: Teaching methodology, faculty, certifications, and industry exposure knowledge for the MERI Admission Voice Agent.

examples: How is teaching done at MERI?
faqs.answer: MERI combines classroom teaching with case studies, seminars, workshops, conferences, guest lectures, group discussions, industrial training, and study tours.
Yes, the curriculum uses case-based learning, live projects, and workshop participation to build practical business skills alongside classroom theory.
MERI's teaching involves a mix of academic faculty and industry speakers who bring in real-world business experience. Detailed faculty profiles can be shared by the admissions team.
MERI offers 20-plus skill enhancement programs and certificate courses as part of the curriculum to add value beyond the core degree.
Yes, MERI regularly hosts guest lectures, media talks, alumni talks, and entrepreneurial talks from industry professionals.

examples: What industry exposure do you provide?
faqs.answer: Students get industry exposure through workshops, seminars, internships, guest lectures, and industrial training as part of the experiential learning model.

examples: Is there a student exchange program?
faqs.answer: MERI has tie-ups with 26 foreign universities that support student exchange and global exposure opportunities.
